data.long_meaning: Azzu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'azz', which means 'shining' or 'resplendent'. It is a name that signifies radiance and brilliance. In Hindu mythology, Azzu is associated with the sun god Surya and represents the power of light and illumination. The name Azzu carries the meaning “Resplendent, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Azzu usually hope their child will grow to embody resplendent, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
